findings.title: ComposableParamOrder
findings.diagnosis:
Parameters in a composable function should be ordered following this pattern: params without defaults, modifiers, params with defaults and optionally, a trailing function that might not have a default param.
Current params are: [optional: String = "", required: Int] but could be [required: Int, optional: String = ""].
See https://mrmans0n.github.io/compose-rules/rules/#ordering-composable-parameters-properly for more information.
findings.whyItMatters: Maintained compose-rules v0.6.8 implements this individually registered rule; see its tagged implementation and guideline for the actual detection contract. Most pack guidance expresses code/API conventions, potential state/effect mistakes, or performance advice; no universal defect is implied by registration or default configuration.
